main.name: Main Island
main.description: Your approved 12-plot farm, home and Cloud Chicken barn.

botanical.name: Botanical Island
botanical.description: Grow medicinal herbs separately from the 12 farm plots; brew specific cures and species food.

dragon.name: Dragon Island
dragon.description: Build the Dragon Altar, incubate elemental eggs and use one companion utility at a time.

monster.name: Monster Island
monster.description: Slimes recover garden supplies; golems collect a small amount of building stone.

ice.name: Ice Island
ice.description: An icehouse preserves care meters and unlocks cold-water fish and frost herbs.

lava.name: Lava Island
lava.description: The warm forge reduces queued crafting and incubation time by one day.

snake.name: Snake Island
snake.description: Grow antidote herbs and assign a serpent to reduce creature disease risk.
